definitions.explanation: Widely known by many people. Can describe people, places, or things.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{歌手|かしゅ}です。
この{料理|りょうり}は{有名|ゆうめい}ですね。
examples.english: This dish is famous, isn't it?

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}で{一番|いちばん}{有名|ゆうめい}な{山|やま}は{富士山|ふじさん}です。
examples.english: The most famous mountain in Japan is Mt. Fuji.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}は{桜|さくら}で{有名|ゆうめい}です。{毎年|まいとし}{春|はる}になると、{大勢|おおぜい}の{人|ひと}が{見|み}に{来|き}ます。
examples.english: This town is famous for its cherry blossoms. Every spring, many people come to see them.

notes: {有名|ゆうめい} is a na-adjective: {有名|ゆうめい}な (before nouns), {有名|ゆうめい}だ/です (predicate), {有名|ゆうめい}じゃない (negative), {有名|ゆうめい}だった (past). The kanji literally mean 'have name' - something so notable it has a name. Antonym: {無名|むめい} (unknown, obscure).
